
```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Pseudo-spectral acceleration design values PSA [%s] for return periods from %s to %s yr, structural periods Tn from %g to %g s, reference site conditions Vs30 = %s m/s, and fractile p = %s."
if (!exists("PSA_Units")) PSA_Units <- "cm/s2"
if (!exists("Tn.target")) Tn.target <- Tn.gmdp
if (!exists("TR.target")) TR.target <- TR.gmdp
if (!exists("p.target"))  p.target  <- "mean"
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveDerivedIDTarget(
  UHSTable,
  "PSA.qmd",
  suffix = ".max",
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
root <- here::here()
```
